messages.content: The Palmer House room is now booked. The organizer moved my Friday morning rights meeting to the Silversmith. Is it worth changing hotels before the March 23 cancellation deadline?

Probably not. The Silversmith is about a 12-minute walk from the Palmer House, so moving would save roughly 20 minutes round trip that morning. It would also mean replacing a confirmed three-night reservation, and the Silversmith previously lacked conference-rate availability for the full stay.
The meeting starts at 8:30 and everything else is still at the Palmer House. My flights have not changed.

Keep the Palmer House. Leaving around 8:10 should provide a modest walking buffer, while relocating would make the rest of the conference less convenient. No booking action is warranted. Retain the March 23 at 11:59 p.m. Chicago-time cancellation cutoff in case the schedule changes again before then.
